name: Dino Quest VR
summary:
Step into the world of Dino Quest VR, an adventure where exploration, survival, fossil hunting, and dinosaurs come to life around you.

Travel across mysterious islands filled with ancient ruins, hidden caves, dangerous jungles, and realistic dinosaur encounters. Use interactive VR tools to excavate fossils, solve environmental puzzles, unlock secrets, and survive terrifying predators in an immersive world built for virtual reality.
